title: Shadow Dance
style: Cyberpunk neon retro-hell digital pop art, THICK bold outlines, magenta cyan acid yellow, futuristic — NOT photoreal. Hero likeness from reference rendered in this art style only.
story: She lets it fall — dancing with her neon shadow through retro-hell streets until the shadow and the self become one rhythm.
